notes: The former circuit owner and championship organizer identify the 2.6 km Grand Prix course and its over-under northern loop, before closure for housing in 2010. The full western technical return, southern main straight, eastern sweep and two-level northern crossing are independently digitized from the original-grid NSW Historical Imagery 2005 tiles. The northern standalone oval, internal short connectors, pits, southern dirt course and neighboring fields are excluded. Dataset-specific metadata declares Creative Commons reuse and identifies Spatial Services aerial capture; the linked copyright policy specifies CC BY 4.0 attribution. The exact 49 tile requests, hashes, Web Mercator origin and extent are pinned. Historical rectification targets +/-20 m for 95 percent of the 100k map sheet; detailed pavement pixels do not imply equivalent GPS accuracy. The figure-eight crossing is traversed twice as distinct sections of one course, with no turn or invented junction at the crossing. Corner placement, racing direction and historical-year correspondence remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing locations or nominal distance. The supplied timing marker is roughly 40 m from the unchanged draft trace. Closed-course timing-proximity validation accounts for the provider-documented 20 m rectification uncertainty; neither geometry nor marker is shifted and timing remains unverified. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2628.1 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved border rings. Elevation follows the approximately 63 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source trace and borders have too many unmatched cross-sections for safe lap reconstruction. Lap playback is unavailable. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.
